setup_boost: clone boost repository and copy mqtt5 library source into boost root for CI setup
build_b2_distro: build a boost distribution using b2 install with a specified toolset like gcc
build_cmake_distro: build a boost distribution using cmake with specified generator build type and cxx standard
run_b2_tests: run the mqtt5 library tests using b2 with specified variant cxx standard and toolset
build_docs: generate documentation for the mqtt5 library using b2 with doxygen and boostbook
